case: Direct video playback investigation and fallback verification
root_cause: Automated Chromium cannot decode the sample MP4/H.264 format: canPlayType('video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42E01E"') returns empty, MediaError.code=4. The exact same sample host serves HTTP206 with video/mp4 and byte-range support. WebM is supported and plays. This is a test-browser codec limitation, not Mongo persistence or host/CORS failure.
changes: Localized format-specific playback error in AboutVideo instead of attributing every media failure to film availability.
Retry button remounts player; direct-open video link retained.
verified: MP4 URL saves and persists; unsupported-codec message, retry and direct-open URL checked.
Admin Homepage form saves WebM URL (HTTP200); preview currentTime advances while playing.
Homepage native WebM currentTime advances while playing; reload retains saved URL.
Admin Remove returns204 and clears preview/homepage player.
All temporary video settings restored to original empty/null configuration.
test_execution_note: One forced-pointer test clicked an obscured header element after scrolling, leaving /admin before the next save. Repeated with explicit page/response assertions and native Enter form submission; save, preview, home playback and removal all passed.
remaining_limitations: H.264 MP4 playback itself cannot be verified in this Chromium build; requires a browser supporting that codec.
Owner must supply a public company video; YouTube/Vimeo embedding remains subject to provider/video permissions.
